title: Five CVPR 2026 papers: towards agentic 3D vision systems
blurb: Five papers accepted to CVPR 2026, presented at the main conference in Denver. Together they trace one line — from raw pixels to geometry to dynamics to agents: UnReflectAnything cleans the input, ConceptPose and OPT-Pose understand unseen objects, Node-RF learns the dynamics.

title: Joint DLR–TUM workshop on photogrammetry and remote sensing
blurb: PRS co-organised an exchange workshop with the German Aerospace Center at its Remote Sensing Technology Institute in Oberpfaffenhofen — a day of presentations, technical discussion and strategic planning with the RST and RSA groups from TUM.

title: Fully funded PhD positions through MCML
blurb: The Munich Center for Machine Learning — a joint TUM and LMU initiative — funds full PhD positions in machine learning, computer vision and AI. PRS welcomes candidates working on 3D computer vision, generative world modelling and multimodal perception.

title: Benjamin Busam takes over the Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing Lab
blurb: Professor and Director of PRS since 1 September 2025, returning to the institution where his academic path began — by way of ParisTech, Melbourne, FRAMOS, Huawei Research London and, until 2025, the Chair for Computer Aided Medical Procedures at TUM.

title: Making machines see and think in 3D
blurb: We build 3D in silico replicas of our world — reconstruction, semantic understanding and multimodal sensor fusion, from satellite and aerial imagery down to mobile and embodied sensing. From sensor to system.

title: Open: uncertainty-aware 4D world models, with Cambridge
blurb: A master's thesis or guided research project on modelling uncertainty under noise, occlusion and sensor degradation, so 4D reconstruction stays reliable outside the lab.
